name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. domain=chapter_event_handler; '25' is the per-event handler-table index 0x25 at 0x51B91 (a meaningful dispatch/event-slot ID, same scheme as all sibling handlers 00..2E in this file), not an address remnant; '__unref' = no FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook references this slot (xref-to is only the table data slot at 0x51c25, 0 direct callers); 'major_cinematic' = its category (2-stage cutscene). No hex address suffix. Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Unreferenced (cut-content/non-chapter) major endgame cinematic event handler, dispatch slot 0x25: show dialog page 1 then play a 2-stage portrait+cutscene cinematic and flip battle-animation phase to 1.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no branch/RNG/numeric-compute, no CALL-return used. fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=1, fixed dialog geometry). Stage A: fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0xF,0x22); chapter_init_phase_flag=1; fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(3); chapter_init_phase_flag=0; fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x2B); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(). Stage B: fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0,0x1A); chapter_init_phase_flag=1; fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(4); chapter_init_phase_flag=0; fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x2C); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(). Closes with battle_anim_phase=1. Each portrait load is bracketed by the init-phase flag. __CHK(0x28) prologue; EBX untouched; final store reached via tail-JMP 0x34D63 -> 0x35C18 (MOV [0x51A83],1; RET) shared epilogue tail, inlined in src for Layer-2 equivalence.

params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl dispatch argument per the per-event handler table at 0x51B91; body never reads it (cast to void). Same arg convention as every sibling handler in this file.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the file-wide convention for this dispatch family, no address remnant; param is unread so a generic-but-meaningful 'event_arg' is the correct name.

data_fd2_battle_anim_phase (@ 0x51a83, set to 1 at end via shared tail at 0x35C18)
